title: Most of subscibed feeds gone only from the web app
summary: Hi, recently most of my feeds disappeared from the web app. Interestingly, in the Android app, they are still there. I tried logging in from an entirely different browser (I am on Zen-Firefox; I tried on Edge), but the issue still persists. How can I force a refresh or something like that? I made an OPML backup from the Android app just in case.
body_markdown:
[jarartur](https://forum.newsblur.com/u/jarartur)


October 2, 2026, 8:09am 1


Hi, recently most of my feeds disappeared from the web app. Interestingly, in the Android app, they are still there. I tried logging in from an entirely different browser (I am on Zen-Firefox; I tried on Edge), but the issue still persists.


How can I force a refresh or something like that? I made an OPML backup from the Android app just in case.


[samuelclay](https://forum.newsblur.com/u/samuelclay)


October 2, 2026, 1:35pm 2


They are still there, you just moved into Focus mode. It’s at the bottom of the feed list.


[jarartur](https://forum.newsblur.com/u/jarartur)


October 5, 2026, 8:20am 3


I feel so dumb right now. You are of course correct. I don’t know why I haven’t noticed that.
